acceptanceCriteria: corvint-js-test-provider runs Jest with a retained run receipt that test-validity consumes for run outcome and freshness, or the spec records Jest as a deferred provider with reasons.
body: After V1-2041, Jest test validity is static only: measured strength, run outcome and freshness are NOT_APPLICABLE because no Jest run receipt exists (TSA-V0-390).
title: Jest run provider: corvint-js-test-provider runs only Vitest and Playwright, so Jest has no run-based validity axes
